shortDescription: Adds a new custom DLP dictionary.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: bin_numbers
options.description: The list of Bank Identification Number (BIN) values that are included or excluded from the Credit Cards dictionary. BIN values can be specified only for Diners Club, Mastercard, RuPay, and Visa cards. Up to 512 BIN values can be configured in a dictionary.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: confidence_threshold
options.description: The DLP confidence threshold

options.name: custom_phrase_match_type
options.description: The DLP confidence threshold

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the DLP dictionary

options.name: dict_template_id
options.description: ID of the predefined dictionary (original source dictionary) that is used for cloning. This field is applicable only to cloned dictionaries. Only a limited set of identification-based predefined dictionaries (e.g., Credit Cards, Social Security Numbers, National Identification Numbers, etc.) can be cloned. Up to 4 clones can be created from a predefined dictionary.

options.name: dictionary_type
options.description: The DLP dictionary type.

options.name: exact_data_match_details
options.description: Exact Data Match (EDM) related information for custom DLP dictionaries.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the DLP dictionary

options.name: idm_profile_match_accuracy
options.description: Exact Data Match (EDM) related information for custom DLP dictionaries.

options.name: ignore_exact_match_idm_dict
options.description: Indicates whether to exclude documents that are a 100% match to already-indexed documents from triggering an Indexed Document Match (IDM) Dictionary.

options.name: include_bin_numbers
options.description: A true value denotes that the specified Bank Identification Number (BIN) values are included in the Credit Cards dictionary. A false value denotes that the specified BIN values are excluded from the Credit Cards dictionary.

options.name: name
options.description: The DLP dictionary's name

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: patterns
options.description: List containing the patterns used within a custom DLP dictionary.

options.name: phrases
options.description: List containing the phrases used within a custom DLP dictionary.

options.name: predefined_count_action_type
options.description: This field specifies whether duplicate matches of a phrase from a dictionary must be counted individually or toward the match count or ignored, thereby maintaining a single count for multiple occurrences.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: proximity
options.description: The DLP dictionary proximity length.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
